notes.title: .036 Patch notes
notes.content:
Third day in a row! Just a couple of fixes this time:
[list]
[*] You can no longer enter the spawn areas in level 2
[*] Mini Boss can no longer be stunned
[/list]

notes.title: .035 Patch notes
notes.content:
Just a short update today:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an audio bug with sound fx volume
[*] Zombies now display a hit reaction against most types of attacks. They will briefly stop moving while they react, and there will be blood spatter. Fire and Knockback (baseball bat, kick) do not utilize these effects.
[/olist]

Thanks, and have fun!

notes.title: Demo .34 patch notes
notes.content:
Based on player feedback, I have made the decision to move the Build Barricade action to its own... action... as opposed to being part of Interact. It was too confusing, particularly when trying to rescue coworkers. Starting with this release, the Y button on a Xbox controller, or the Q button on your keyboard, will build a barricade. Other Interactions remain unchanged.

Level 1 also features a new melee weapon, the cutting blade from a guillotine paper cutter! It swings very swiftly, and if you can time it properly it will kill a zombie in one swipe.

Have fun, and thanks for playing!

-Mark
